plain_english_summary: Not an app change: fixes a bug where the very first automated permission check of a new development session would block itself, plus adds a written incident report explaining what happened.
correct_agent_response: The bug fix itself is code complete and verified: confirmed the diff adds the missing exemption, matching the same exemption an adjacent check already had. Flagged separately, for hygiene rather than correctness: this commit also bundles an unrelated draft article about the incident into the same change as the code fix. Not a defect in the fix itself, but worth surfacing rather than folding silently into a plain 'Code complete.'
